query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.nameJa, c.cardNumber, 
       AVG(CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as avgPrice,
       MIN(CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as minPrice,
       MAX(CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as maxPrice,
       COUNT(*) as transactionCount
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN priceHistory ph ON c.id = ph.cardId
WHERE (c.name LIKE '%Lillie%Full Force%' OR c.nameJa LIKE '%リーリエの全力%')
  AND ph.source = 'snkrdunk'
  AND ph.grade = 'PSA10'
  AND ph.soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 DAY)
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.nameJa, c.cardNumber
LIMIT 5;
